title: IGG: A Benchmark for Interactive GUI Grounding under Visibility Constraints
title_zh: IGG：可见性约束下的交互式GUI定位基准

paragraphs.en: GUI grounding benchmarks ask whether an agent can localize a target that is already visible in a static screenshot. Real interfaces often violate this assumption: a target may be off-screen, appear only after a state change or hover, remain occluded, or become actionable after a delay. This leaves the ability to recover target visibility unevaluated. To measure this reveal step, we introduce Interactive GUI Grounding (IGG) 1 1 1 The benchmark and code are available at https://igg-bench.github.io/ . , a benchmark in which an agent must first make the target visible through interaction and then click it. IGG contains 601 tasks across 16 controllable GUI environments and seven visibility-constraint sub-types, with a compact action space of scrolling, moving, dragging, waiting, and clicking. In our human study, participants achieve 94.6% accuracy, while GPT-5.5 reaches 79.4% and the strongest evaluated open-source VLM reaches only 31.6%. To identify the source of this gap, we conduct two controlled interventions. Telling Qwen3-VL which interaction to perform raises its accuracy only from 30.8% to 33.9%, whereas performing the interaction for the model raises it to 81.9%. The bottleneck is executing the reveal interaction, not recognizing the target once it is exposed. We further show that this capability is learnable, demonstrating that visibility recovery can be strengthened consistently across model families.

paragraphs.en: GUI agents increasingly rely on vision-language models (VLMs) to map natural-language instructions to screen locations Wu et al. (2025) ; Mittal et al. (2026) ; Koh et al. (2024) ; Kumbhar et al. (2026) ; Gao et al. (2024) ; Zheng et al. (2024) . Existing grounding benchmarks evaluate this mapping within a single screenshot and typically assume that the target is already visible Cheng et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2025) . However, routine interfaces often violate this assumption (Figure 2 ): a target may lie outside the viewport Burigat et al. (2012) , sit in a collapsed panel, be covered by a popup, be distinguishable from its neighbors only on hover, or activate only after a delay. In each case, no static grounding model, however accurate, can localize the target in the initial screenshot. The agent must first select and execute an interaction that reveals it, and only then recognize and click it. Static grounding benchmarks leave this reveal step unmeasured, and navigation benchmarks fold it into end-to-end task success, where it cannot be separated from planning. In light of this gap, this paper asks whether current GUI agents can make a target visible before grounding it and, when they cannot, at which stage they fail.

paragraphs.en: To fill this gap, we introduce Interactive GUI Grounding (IGG) to measure this missing step. An IGG episode decomposes success into four stages: selecting a reveal action , executing it at the correct location or with the correct parameters , recognizing the target once it appears , and localizing the final click . We call the first two stages visibility recovery . The remaining stages, recognizing the target once it appears and localizing the click, coincide with static grounding (Section 3.1 ). Thus, like static grounding, IGG scores a single final click. Unlike static grounding, it additionally requires the agent to recover the target’s visibility beforehand. Because interaction serves only to expose the target, IGG isolates visibility recovery without introducing the broader planning demands of full GUI navigation.
paragraphs.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们提出交互式 GUI 定位（IGG）来衡量这一缺失的步骤。 一个 IGG 回合将成功分解为四个阶段：选择一个揭示动作、在正确位置或以正确参数执行该动作、在目标出现后识别它，以及对最终点击进行定位。 我们将前两个阶段称为可见性恢复。 其余两个阶段，即在目标出现后识别目标以及对点击进行定位，与静态定位一致（见 3.1 节）。 因此，与静态定位一样，IGG 对单次最终点击进行评分。 与静态定位不同的是，它额外要求智能体事先恢复目标的可见性。 由于交互仅用于暴露目标，IGG 在不引入完整 GUI 导航中更广泛的规划需求的情况下，单独衡量了可见性恢复能力。

paragraphs.en: IGG contains 601 tasks across 16 controllable GUI environments modeled on familiar applications. Tasks fall into seven sub-types under three constraint types, Viewport , Multi-State , and Temporal/Manipulation , and are solved with five actions: Scroll , Move , Drag , Wait , and Click . Deterministic initial states and stable target identities make evaluation replayable at click time, while the environments preserve the interaction patterns that make visibility recovery difficult: hover reveals, popups, delayed activation, carousels, and movable occlusions.
paragraphs.zh: IGG 包含 601 个任务，涵盖 16 个以常见应用为原型的可控制图形界面环境。 任务分为三大约束类型（视口（Viewport）、多状态（Multi-State）和时序/操作（Temporal/Manipulation））下的七个子类型，并使用五种动作求解：滚动（Scroll）、移动（Move）、拖拽（Drag）、等待（Wait）和点击（Click）。 确定性的初始状态和稳定的目标标识使评估可以在点击时刻进行重放，同时这些环境保留了使可见性恢复变得困难的交互模式：悬停显示、弹窗、延迟激活、轮播以及可移动的遮挡物。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments identify interaction execution as the main bottleneck in IGG. Telling a model which interaction to perform provides little improvement, whereas performing the reveal action for it recovers most of its accuracy. SFT on successful interaction trajectories followed by online GRPO further improves visibility recovery across Qwen3-VL, InternVL3.5, and GUI-Owl-1.5.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验发现，交互执行是 IGG 的主要瓶颈。 告诉模型执行哪种交互几乎不会带来提升，而替模型执行揭示动作则能恢复其大部分准确率。 在成功交互轨迹上进行 SFT 之后再用在线 GRPO 进一步提升，可在 Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5 和 GUI-Owl-1.5 上持续改善可见性恢复效果。

paragraphs.en: We formulate interactive GUI grounding as visibility recovery followed by target recognition and localization, separating it from both static grounding and end-to-end navigation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将交互式 GUI 定位（grounding）形式化为可见性恢复，随后进行目标识别与定位，从而将其与静态定位以及端到端导航区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We introduce IGG, a benchmark of 601 tasks, 16 controllable GUI environments, and seven visibility-constraint sub-types, together with a click-time evaluator and human-verified ground-truth interaction trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍 IGG，一个包含 601 个任务、16 个可控 GUI 环境和七种可见性约束子类型的基准测试，同时提供点击时评估器和经人工验证的真实交互轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We provide controlled interventions, heuristic analyses, cross-viewport and paired mock-real evaluations, and training studies that identify where current agents fail and show consistent improvements across three VLM architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了受控干预、启发式分析、跨视口与配对“模拟-真实”评估以及训练研究，以识别当前智能体在哪些方面失败，并展示了在三种 VLM 架构上的一致改进。

paragraphs.en: GUI grounding maps a natural-language instruction to the corresponding interface element ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Tang et al., 2025 ) . ScreenSpot ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) , ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and OSWorld-G ( Xie et al., 2025 ) evaluate localization within a screenshot where the target is visible. Recent methods improve this setting through rich screenshot supervision ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , diffusion-based prediction ( Kumbhar et al., 2026 ) , UI decomposition ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , and multi-turn refinement ( Mittal et al., 2026 ) . Universal grounding extends localization to agent settings ( Gou et al., 2025 ) , but still predicts a target from the currently observed state. IGG instead evaluates the preceding visibility-recovery step: the agent must change the interface before the target can be recognized and localized.
paragraphs.zh: GUI grounding 将自然语言指令映射到相应的界面元素（Cheng et al., 2024；Tang et al., 2025）。 ScreenSpot（Cheng et al., 2024）、ScreenSpot-Pro（Li et al., 2025）和 OSWorld-G（Xie et al., 2025）评估的是目标在截图中可见时的定位能力。 近期方法通过丰富的截图监督（Gao et al., 2024）、基于扩散的预测（Kumbhar et al., 2026）、UI 分解（Xie et al., 2025）以及多轮细化（Mittal et al., 2026）来改进这一设定。 通用 grounding 将定位扩展到智能体场景（Gou et al., 2025），但仍然是根据当前观测到的状态来预测目标。 IGG 评估的是此前的可见性恢复步骤：智能体必须先改变界面，然后才能识别和定位目标。

paragraphs.en: Mind2Web ( Deng et al., 2023 ) , WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) evaluate multi-step task completion on web and desktop interfaces, and agent-side improvements such as interaction-history compression ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) are measured against their end-to-end success. Because only end-to-end success is scored, planning, exploration, and grounding failures collapse into a single signal. IGG instead scores one narrower capability, visibility recovery followed by a single evaluated click (Section 3.1 ). Just as static grounding was separated from navigation and became a standard evaluation axis ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) , IGG isolates a step that navigation benchmarks contain only implicitly, and it complements rather than replaces them.

paragraphs.en: We categorize tasks by the interaction required to recover target visibility (Figures 1 and 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据恢复目标可见性所需的交互方式对任务进行分类（图 1 和图 2）。

paragraphs.en: The target is outside the current viewport but reachable within the same UI state.
paragraphs.zh: 目标不在当前视口内，但在同一 UI 状态下可到达。

paragraphs.en: CT1-1. Scroll-based Exploration: The target is off-screen and must be revealed by scrolling within the current state.
paragraphs.zh: CT1-1. 基于滚动的探索：目标在屏幕外，需要在当前状态下通过滚动才能显示出来。

sents.en: Scroll-based Exploration: The target is off-screen and must be revealed by scrolling within the current state.
sents.zh: 基于滚动的探索：目标在屏幕外，需要在当前状态下通过滚动才能显示出来。

paragraphs.en: The target, or the visual cue needed to identify it, is hidden by the current UI state and must be revealed through a state-changing interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 目标，或识别它所需的视觉线索，被当前 UI 状态所遮挡，必须通过改变状态的交互才能显现出来。

paragraphs.en: CT2-1. Visual Disambiguation: The target is visually similar to other elements and can only be distinguished through hover-based cues such as tooltips or labels, requiring a Move before the final Click .
paragraphs.zh: CT2-1. 视觉消歧：目标在视觉上与其他元素相似，只能通过基于悬停的提示（如工具提示或标签）加以区分，因此在最终点击之前需要先进行移动。

paragraphs.en: CT2-2. Hidden State Activation: The target is contained in a collapsed or inactive UI region, such as a dropdown, tab, or side panel, that must be opened before clicking.
paragraphs.zh: CT2-2。 隐藏状态激活：目标元素位于折叠或未激活的 UI 区域中，例如下拉菜单、选项卡或侧边面板，必须在点击之前先将其展开。

paragraphs.en: CT3-1. Delayed State Activation: The target is initially inactive and becomes interactable only after a temporal delay or asynchronous event, requiring a Wait before clicking.

paragraphs.en: We want environments that are deterministic enough to score a click programmatically, yet rich enough in interaction to make visibility recovery difficult. IGG comprises 601 tasks across 16 controllable environments modeled on widely used applications such as Gmail, Google Calendar, VS Code, Figma, Spotify, and YouTube (full list in Appendix A ). 2 2 2 Real applications are named as canonical references only, and no affiliation with or endorsement by their owners is implied. Each environment is a deterministic web application: every task starts from a fixed initial state, state transitions are reproducible, and every element carries a stable identifier, so the evaluator decides success at click time without heuristic matching. At the same time, the environments implement the interaction patterns that visibility recovery requires, including hover reveals, collapsible panels, popups, delayed activation, carousels, and draggable occluders.

paragraphs.en: Tasks are built in three steps. A multimodal agent first drafts a goal-only instruction and a reference trace for each target. Annotators then rewrite instructions that leak the procedure (“Click ‘Reply’ on Minji’s message” rather than “Hover over the message and click ‘Reply’ ”, as in Figure A10 ) and add a natural disambiguating cue, such as an author, title, or surrounding content, when several elements share a label (Appendix C.3 ). Finally, annotators replay every trace to confirm that the target is unique and reachable. Figure 3 shows the resulting distribution over sub-types and environments.
paragraphs.zh: 任务通过三个步骤构建。 多模态智能体首先为每个目标起草仅含目标的指令和参考轨迹。 随后标注员重写泄露操作流程的指令（例如“在 Minji 的消息上点击‘回复’”，而非“将鼠标悬停在消息上并点击‘回复’”，见图 A10），并在多个元素共享同一标签时添加自然的消歧线索，例如作者、标题或上下文内容（附录 C.3）。 最后，标注员回放每条轨迹，以确认目标是唯一且可到达的。 图 3 展示了所得的子类型与环境分布。

paragraphs.en: IGG combines task specifications, 16 controllable GUI environments, and a Playwright-driven Chromium evaluator at a × 900 1440\!\times\!900 viewport. On each CLICK , the evaluator compares the clicked element ID with the target ID; a match ends the episode, while a mismatch returns the updated screenshot. Models receive only screenshots, the goal-only instruction, and action history. The DOM, accessibility tree, target ID, and ground-truth interaction trajectory remain hidden. Each baseline is evaluated once per task after an environment reset; main runs use an eight-action budget and greedy decoding unless noted. Table D provides the prompts, decoding settings, and action formats.

paragraphs.en: Participants solve a fixed suite of 21 tasks, three from each sub-type, using the same instructions and interfaces given to the models, without the constraint label, target ID, target coordinates, or reveal procedure. A trial ends on the correct target click or after eight click-or-drag attempts. Scrolling and hovering are recorded but do not count, so the limit is comparable to, though not identical with, the eight-action model budget. paragraphs.en: We introduced IGG to make visibility recovery a measurable component of GUI grounding. Our analyses show that knowing which interaction is required is not enough; current models most often fail in deciding where and how to carry it out. Training on successful interaction trajectories followed by online feedback improves this capability consistently across model families. IGG therefore provides a focused setting for evaluating and learning the interactions that must precede a grounding click.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入 IGG，使可见性恢复成为 GUI grounding（图形界面定位）中一个可度量的组成部分。 我们的分析表明，知道需要哪种交互是不够的；当前模型最常见的失败在于无法决定在哪里以及如何执行该交互。 在成功的交互轨迹上进行训练并辅以在线反馈，能够跨多个模型家族一致地提升这一能力。 因此，IGG 提供了一个聚焦的评测与学习场景，用于评估和学习那些必须先于定位点击发生的交互。

paragraphs.en: IGG uses deterministic mockups for controlled and reproducible evaluation. Our fidelity analyses, including paired mock-real evaluation, suggest that these environments capture relevant visual and interaction patterns, but they do not replace evaluation on live interfaces. Interactive grounding can support accessibility and UI testing, but the same capability may also be misused for automated interaction. We therefore release only controlled mockups that are not connected to external services.

paragraphs.en: We measure visual similarity between each mockup and its corresponding real-application reference listed in Table A1 . We compare each matched mock-real pair against non-matched pairs formed by pairing the mockup with the other 15 real-application references. We compute feature-space cosine similarities using DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) and SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) , and perceptual distance using DreamSim ( Fu et al., 2023 ) . As shown in Table A3 , matched pairs are substantially more similar than non-matched pairs, with higher DINO similarity (0.7724 vs. 0.5442), higher SigLIP similarity (0.8094 vs. 0.6211), and lower DreamSim distance (0.2529 vs. 0.5229). These results indicate that the mockups preserve application-level visual structure beyond generic webpage appearance.

paragraphs.en: Instructions name the target but not the reveal procedure. Annotators avoid action hints such as “scroll down,” “hover over the icon,” or “wait until the button appears,” and add a natural cue, such as an author, document title, or surrounding content, when several elements share a label. For example, “Scroll down and click Kai” becomes “Find Kai in the direct message list,” and “Drag the sticky note away and click QA Checklist” becomes “Click the QA Checklist note without deleting any notes.” Multimodal LLMs propose candidate instructions and reference traces, and annotators correct the wording, repair traces where needed, and replay every task to verify that the target is unique and reachable.
paragraphs.zh: 指令只说明目标，但不说明揭示操作步骤。 标注者会避免诸如“向下滚动”“悬停在图标上”或“等待按钮出现”之类的操作提示，并在多个元素共享同一标签时添加自然线索，例如作者、文档标题或周围内容。 例如，“向下滚动并点击 Kai”会改为“在私信列表中找到 Kai”，“把便签拖开并点击 QA Checklist”会改为“在不删除任何便签的情况下点击 QA Checklist 便签”。多模态大语言模型提出候选指令和引用轨迹，标注者修正措辞、在需要时修复轨迹，并重放每个任务以验证目标的唯一性和可到达性。

paragraphs.en: As a diagnostic, we also evaluate instructions that state the intermediate procedure. Unlike the reveal action given condition of Section 4.3 , which names only the action type, these hints describe the procedure. With such hints, Qwen3-VL rises from 30.8% to 56.9% GA over all 601 tasks, but hints do not solve precise manipulation: hinted Qwen3-VL solves 0 of 8 held-out movable-occlusion tasks, whereas SFT+GRPO solves 5 of 8 without any test-time hint. The main benchmark therefore retains goal-only instructions, and the training gains reflect an executable interaction prior rather than instruction following.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一种诊断手段，我们还评估了显式说明中间步骤的指令。 与第 4.3 节中仅指明动作类型的「给定条件下揭示动作」不同，这些提示描述的是具体过程。 在此类提示下，Qwen3-VL 在全部 601 个任务上的 GA 从 30.8% 提升到 56.9%，但提示无法解决精确操作问题：带提示的 Qwen3-VL 在 8 个留出的可移动遮挡任务中解出 0 个，而 SFT+GRPO 在没有任何测试时提示的情况下解出 8 个中的 5 个。 因此主基准仅保留只含目标的指令，训练带来的增益反映的是可执行的交互先验，而非指令遵循能力。

paragraphs.en: Each task record contains a goal-only instruction, a target ID, an initial state, and one successful reference trace (Listing 1 ). paragraphs.en: To separate reveal patterns that a fixed rule can solve from those that require target-specific decisions, we evaluate five target-agnostic heuristics, each on the sub-type it is designed for: scrolling the page center in fixed steps, hovering over common icon regions in order, clicking common dismiss locations, waiting in one-second steps, and dragging visible occluders toward the screen edge. A heuristic succeeds when the target becomes visible, unobstructed, and actionable (Table A7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了区分哪些揭示模式可以由固定规则解决、哪些需要针对特定目标的决策，我们评估了五种与目标无关的启发式方法，每种方法都在其设计所针对的子类型上进行测试：以固定步长滚动页面中心、按顺序悬停在常见图标区域、点击常见的关闭位置、以一秒为步长进行等待，以及将可见的遮挡元素拖向屏幕边缘。 当目标变得可见、无遮挡且可操作时，该启发式方法即视为成功（表 A7）。

paragraphs.en: Fixed rules often resolve scrolling, hovering, and waiting, but rarely resolve removable or movable occlusions. This agrees with the trace analysis in Section F.2 , where Drag is absent from every failed trajectory that requires it.

paragraphs.en: Our two-stage procedure uses SFT to introduce rare reveal actions and online GRPO to optimize their execution from browser feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的两阶段流程使用 SFT 引入稀有的揭示动作，并使用在线 GRPO 从浏览器反馈中优化其执行。

paragraphs.en: Two tasks whose ground-truth trajectories could not be replayed reliably during corpus construction are excluded before splitting the remaining 599 tasks into 479 training tasks and 120 held-out validation tasks. Every included ground-truth trajectory is human-corrected and verified by replay; validation tasks contribute neither SFT examples nor GRPO rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 两个任务的真值轨迹在语料库构建期间无法可靠地重放，因此在将其余 599 个任务划分为 479 个训练任务和 120 个留出验证任务之前，这两个任务被排除在外。 每个纳入的真值轨迹都经过人工校正并通过重放验证；验证任务既不贡献 SFT 样本，也不贡献 GRPO 轨迹采样。

paragraphs.en: GRPO starts from an SFT LoRA seed and collects online browser rollouts from the 479 training tasks under the same eight-action budget used in evaluation. We use group size 6, temperature 1.0, top- p p 0.95 for rollout sampling, learning rate 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} , PPO-style clipping with ϵ = 0.2 \epsilon=0.2 , maximum gradient norm 1.0, and up to 20 update groups. We evaluate saved LoRA checkpoints with greedy decoding on the fixed 120-task validation split.
paragraphs.zh: GRPO 从一个 SFT LoRA 种子开始，并在与评估相同的八动作预算下，从 479 个训练任务收集在线浏览器轨迹。 我们在轨迹采样时使用组大小 6、温度 1.0、top-p 0.95，学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁶，采用 PPO 风格的裁剪且 ϵ=0.2，最大梯度范数为 1.0，最多进行 20 个更新组。 我们使用贪婪解码在固定的 120 个任务的验证集划分上评估保存的 LoRA 检查点。

sents.en: GRPO starts from an SFT LoRA seed and collects online browser rollouts from the 479 training tasks under the same eight-action budget used in evaluation.

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides implementation details for the two human studies summarized in Section 4.5 . Fifteen participants completed two browser-based protocols connected to the same environments as model evaluation. In the solvability study, every participant completed a subtype-balanced suite of 21 tasks—three from each of the seven sub-types and at least one from every environment—yielding 315 trials. In the fidelity study, participants compared seven controlled environments with real-interface references and rated visual realism, task executability, and interaction realism on five-point scales.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供了第4.5节中总结的两项人类研究的实现细节。 十五名参与者完成了两个基于浏览器的实验流程，这些流程连接到与模型评估相同的环境。 在可解性研究中，每位参与者完成了一套子类型均衡的21个任务——七个子类型中各三个，且每个环境至少一个——共计315次试验。 在保真度研究中，参与者将七个受控环境与真实界面参照进行比较，并就视觉真实感、任务可执行性和交互真实感按五分制进行评分。
